notes: Raw inputs and components for made items. checked is the date the price was seen on its source: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, or YYYY (year only). An empty checked value means the source shows no date. A price counts as fresh only when its checked date is within 12 months before 2026-10-10 and has month precision. Placeholders are guesses. Unpriced inputs count as $0 and make the item unpriced.

pla_per_kg.note: 2026 B2B guides: 5 to 20 kg lots $8.55 to $10.49 per kg; single spools $18 to $25 per kg (high end shown). The month is not stated, so this is year-only.

petg_per_kg.note: Not searched. Guess only. Replace with a bulk PETG price before trusting printed frames.

fr4_single_sided_per_cm2.note: Single-sided copper-clad FR4 only. Low: Newark's 100 x 160 mm board at $1.43. High: Mouser's 3 x 5 in board at $10.73. Undated.

etchant_ferric_per_l.note: Bulk gallons about $9 to $12 per liter (Takach, 4 gallons for $140). A 1 liter bottle is about $18. Undated. Etchant can be reused, so per-board use is conservative.

magnet_wire_per_kg.note: Low: a March 2026 showroom listing for solid enamelled wire, $11.85 to $13.85 (unit and minimum order unclear). High: Elecify's 0.3 mm, 140 g spool at $6.24, about $44.57 per kg (undated). Bulk asks of $7 to $10 per kg need 300 kg minimum orders. Salvaged wire from old motors and transformers is the cheapest route.

ndfeb_n52_10x2_each.note: JC-Magnetics: $0.26 each at 5,000 or more, $0.30 at 500, $0.46 at 50, and $0.78 at the 25-piece minimum. Undated. Per-disc prices are two to five times the material value, so buy by weight if a supplier will quote.

ndfeb_n52_by_weight_kg.note: Vendor range for N52 by weight (undated). Raw neodymium metal was about $130 to $141 per kg in September 2026 (metal, not magnets). This is the target price for a by-weight quote. One 10 x 2 mm disc weighs about 1.2 g.

bearing_608_each.note: Skateboard 608 bearings sold in 8-packs. VXB lists $9.99 (eBay listing timestamp 2026-02-15). A second 8-pack is $12.40 plus shipping (undated). Per bearing: $1.25 to $1.55.

steel_shaft_each.note: Not searched. Guess only. Salvage a steel rod, or check whether a skateboard axle fits.

electrical_steel_per_kg.note: Q2 2026 benchmarks: China $1.44, US $1.99, Germany $2.09 per kg. This is market research, not a store price. Small lots carry a premium, and grade and orientation change the price. Alibaba M19 lots show $0.85 to $1.70 per kg (undated, unit inferred).

laser_cut_stator_each.note: Laser cutting of one stator lamination set. Not priced. Ask FAU or IEEE whether a laser cutter is available. An external cutting service is unknown.

cell_18650_each.note: Unprotected 18650 cells, undated. China wholesale $1 to $2 each, with quality varying. Panasonic-class cells about $3.09 to $3.19 on a bulk-only page. Protected cells cost $10 to $12. Salvaged cells from laptop packs are free but need testing.

tp4056_module_each.note: Single-cell charger with DW01A protection. eBay listings with August 2026 timestamps at $6.11 to $7.19. Envistia $2.39 (undated). Protection is from listing titles, not datasheets.

at32f421_each.note: LCSC, undated. About $0.43 to $0.81 at the 1,000-piece tier, and $0.85 to $1.37 for single pieces. AM32 lists the AT32F421 as supported.

stm32h743_each.note: Undated. Typical market $5.90 to $7.90 (a supplier guide). DigiKey 990-piece tier $9.38 (authorized channel). LCSC snapshots disagree ($6.62 to $11.49).

icm42688p_each.note: Reel price from DigiKey's 5,000 tier (undated) to $6.50 for one piece (reseller guide dated 2026-08-23). Supply is tight: DigiKey quotes a 45-week lead time and Mouser 53 weeks. Plan for a long lead time or a second source.

esp32c3_mini1_each.note: LCSC page for ESP32-C3-MINI-1-N4, fetched 2026-10-10: $3.06 for one piece and $2.01 at 1,300 pieces, 3,563 in stock. The page shows no price date (footer reads 2025).

sx1262_module_each.note: LoRa module, not a bare chip. Wifiblemodule $4.10 per piece with a validity field to 27 August 2027. Waveshare $7.99. The bare SX1262 chip is $9.04 at DigiKey, probably a 2018 snapshot, so it is not verified for 2026.

sx1280_module_each.note: 2.4 GHz chip or module for an ELRS-style transmitter. AliExpress IC $3.22 and 27 dBm module $4.34 (page about 1,787 days old). Alibaba modules $9.80 to $13.98 (undated).

gnss_atgm336h_each.note: Clone-family GNSS chip, lower performance than u-blox and untested here. LCSC $3.24 for one piece and $1.82 at 1,000 or more, undated. Test it against a u-blox reference before trusting it.

mosfet_30v60a_each.note: The high is a retail price: Tinkersphere $1.75, last updated 06/02/2026 (most likely 2 June), stock nearly gone. The low is a guess. No bulk LCSC price for a 30 V, 60 A MOSFET was found. Replace both before trusting the ESC total.

gate_driver_each.note: Not searched. Guess only. One three-phase gate driver per motor is assumed.

passives_kit_each.note: Resistors, capacitors, connectors and current-sense parts bought in bulk. Estimate only; not searched.

pcb_2layer_100cm2_each.note: 10 x 10 cm, 2-layer, low-markup fab. The JLCPCB homepage lists 5 boards from $2.00 (undated). One user reported $3.50 for five including shipping. Prices are not on the static pages.

pcb_4layer_100cm2_each.note: 4-layer 10 x 10 cm board. Not priced: JLCPCB's calculator is script-driven and no static price was found. Guess only.

gimbal_pot_each.note: Stick potentiometer or hall sensor per axis. Not searched. Guess only.
